title: Panabo City Citizen's Portal configuration
description: Central configuration for the portal. See src/Config/README.md for examples.

site.description: The site's identity: used for page titles, link previews, the sitemap and robots.txt.

url.description: Public address of the site, without a trailing slash. Change this if the portal moves to a custom domain.

name.description: Site name, added after each page title ("Guide Hub | <name>") and shown in link previews.

title.description: Home page title in browser tabs and search results. Keep it under about 70 characters.

description.description: Default description for search results and link previews. Keep it under about 160 characters.

pages.description: Pages of this site, in navbar order. They appear under "Portal" in the footer.

tools.description: NaboTech tools: separate apps that open in a new tab. In the navbar they come after the pages; in the footer they appear under "Tools"; on the home page they're the Community tools cards.

resources.description: Outside links, shown under "Resources" in the footer.

data.description: Where data files are loaded from.

r2Url.description: Where the browser loads the R2 bucket's files from, without a trailing slash. "/data" (recommended): this site's own path, which vercel.json forwards to the bucket, so it works even for visitors whose internet provider blocks r2.dev. Or the bucket's own public URL (a custom domain, or https://pub-….r2.dev), which the browser then fetches directly and which needs a CORS policy. Never the S3 API URL (….r2.cloudflarestorage.com), and never access keys: this file is public. While it's "", the page says no figures are posted yet.

popularGuides.description: "Popular" shortcuts under the home page search bar.

disabled.description: Still shown, but greyed out with a "Soon" label and not clickable.

hidden.description: Not shown anywhere. Handy for switching something back on later.

navbar.description: Show in the top navigation bar.

path.description: Route on this site, starting with "/". It must exist in src/Routes/AppRoute.jsx.

name.description: The app's name, e.g. "NaboMap". Shown in small text on the home page card.

label.description: Short link text for the navbar and footer, e.g. "City Map".

title.description: Heading on the home page card, e.g. "Explore the city".

description.description: One sentence for the home page card.

icon.description: A lucide-react icon name in PascalCase, e.g. "MapPinned". Browse them at https://lucide.dev/icons.

home.description: Show as a card in the home page's Community tools.
